what: A virtual analog synthesizer: three oscillators per voice, two multimode filters, three LFOs, a modulation matrix, up to 16 voices and two parts. With effects, an arpeggiator, a sequencer and a drum machine. The factory sounds and wavetables are installed by its own installer page.
author: J0KERPACK
sounds: licensed: factory sound banks by Manuel Schleis (Vengeance Sound), Alan Marcero and Sete and wavetables by Sete, shared with their permission for this firmware; hi-hat samples recorded by the author
